description:
Everything Tada knows about an app, before you write a journey for it: its features and the journeys that already prove them, the test users Tada can sign in as and their roles, and the map of its screens.
USE THIS FIRST whenever you are about to verify a feature. It tells you whether the feature already exists (so you file under its name instead of inventing a twin), which roles already have a test user (so you do not ask for one Tada has, since asking creates it), and which addresses exist (so the journey goes to real pages).
Then write the journeys yourself and send them with verify_feature. plan_feature is optional: use it only when you do not know what the feature should prove.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name" (e.g. "acme/storefront"). Must already be connected to Tada.

name: about_app
